            base = (base * nCr[c][d]) % MOD;
            return base;
        }

            int n = in.nextInt();
            int K = in.nextInt();

            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (in.nextInt() == 50) cnt50++;
                else cnt100++;
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
                    if (j == 0 || j == i) nCr[i][j] = 1;
                    else nCr[i][j] = (nCr[i-1][j] + nCr[i-1][j-1]) % MOD;
                }

            long[][][] dist = new long[200][200][2];
            long[][][] ways = new long[200][200][2];
            for (int i = 0; i < 200; i++) {

                            int ny = y + take100;
                            int nside = side ^ 1;
                            long nd = d + 1;

                            if (dist[nx][ny][nside] >= nd) {
                                if (dist[nx][ny][nside] > nd) {
                                    dist[nx][ny][nside] = nd;
                                    queue.offer(new State(nx, ny, nside, nd));

            out.println(ways[cnt50][cnt100][1]);

        static class State {
            int x, y, side;

            for (; '0' <= c && c <= '9'; c = read()) val = val * 10 + c - '0';
